title: Dating the Boston photograph and brothers' letters
summary: They conclude it predates Chicago, about 1911-12, with Freddie writing home after he left.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Wait, maybe we can push that up there. Yeah. Now, is it got any writing back here? Something, but I don't see what it is for sure. No, they ain't got nothing. No, I guess it doesn't tell. It was made on an old postcard-sized paper. So I just put this here. You see? It looks to me like it might have been when he was still with that Creole band, with the Barkay and all, do you think? Well, when he was up there with Barkay and then for a garden. It looks to me like that period with the uniform and all like that. It wouldn't have been in the late days in Chicago or anything.
Well, I tell you. No. I believe that was before he went to Chicago.
Yeah, with the horn like that's what he was up there.

Yeah, because I believe, because he used to play with, he bucked against Malporez in the same band with Malporez on a parade. I'll never forget that. It looks like shortly after he left here, that's before he left them here. It might have been before he then, but still, what about? Before he left them here, he was good.
Yeah, he bucked Manuel Manez. Yeah, Manuel could tell you exactly. What about that Boston studio, I wonder? Maybe they had the picture taken.

Maybe they had the picture taken over again. Maybe he had something to do over there too, you know? But of course we only suggestin' about, because I'm just only lookin', because he sent word with a letter and I made a remembering something.

He looks very good there. He looks very young. Yeah, he looks better than I does. He must have sent that photograph to you shortly after he left here. He did, he did. Because he sent several of them, you know? Of course. And of course I... He would have got it about 1911 or 1912, something like that. About 1911 or 1912 is right. Because I got it before he, before I left them here, and he had sent all his things before I left them here. Well he sent all his business over here to tell me, you know? Yeah. Because I always just wrote there, but I never would have gotten hauling no returns. I'd write to him and his wife would write to me. Oh yeah. Well I didn't want to hear that. I wanted to hear from him.
